  SDK: assemblyai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: transcripts.submit, transcripts.get
  Setup hints: ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY

  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk

Option 3 — Watson Speech to Text:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text

Option 4 — Azure AI Speech:
  Service: Azure AI Speech
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechRecognizer, recognize_once_async
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/speech-to-text

Option 5 — Cloud Speech-to-Text:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: long_running_recognize, recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs

Option 6 — Alibaba Model Studio ASR:
  Service: Paraformer / Model Studio ASR
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Recognition.call, Paraformer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/speech-recognition

```python
import assemblyai as aai
import os
from typing import Optional, Dict, List

def transcribe_meeting_with_diarization(audio_file_path: str) -> Optional[List[Dict[str, str]]]:
    """
    Transcribes an audio file with speaker diarization using the AssemblyAI API.

    Args:
        audio_file_path: The local path to the audio file to be transcribed.

    Returns:
        A list of dictionaries, where each dictionary represents an utterance
        with 'speaker' and 'text' keys, or None if an error occurs.
    """
    # Implicitly reads ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY from environment variables
    # You can also set it directly: aai.settings.api_key = "YOUR_API_KEY"
    if not os.getenv("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY"):
        print("Error: ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY environment variable not set.")
        return None

    transcriber = aai.Transcriber()

    # Configure the transcription to enable speaker diarization
    config = aai.TranscriptionConfig(speaker_labels=True)

    print(f"Starting transcription for {audio_file_path}...")
    try:
        # The transcribe method handles polling for the result.
        transcript = transcriber.transcribe(audio_file_path, config)

        if transcript.status == aai.TranscriptStatus.ERROR:
            print(f"Transcription failed: {transcript.error}")
            return None

        if not transcript.utterances:
            print("No utterances found in the transcript.")
            return []
            
        print("Transcription complete. Diarized output:")
        
        diarized_result = []
        for utterance in transcript.utterances:
            speaker = utterance.speaker
            text = utterance.text
            print(f"Speaker {speaker}: {text}")
            diarized_result.append({"speaker": speaker, "text": text})
            
        return diarized_result

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
        return None
```
